# The engine's birth and mortality lines on laws, technologies and institutions, moved to script-only types
# (owner, 2026-10-11; docs/superpowers/archive/plans/2026-10-11-demographics-engine-lines-script-only.md): a fixed-sign
# pair per field (P.ENGINE_LINE_FIELDS), re-applied at the two families' sum while te_demog_lines_apply holds.
# A release keeps these files (scripts/release/comment_out_census_inputs.py doesn't read them).
# THIS = ROOT = a state (its monthly pulse, owner change, incorporation and creation; te_demog_events.4 for a new
# game, a law's activation and a technology): each field's pair at the families' sum while te_demog_lines_apply
# holds, touched only when the sum changed; otherwise (the census sets the state's births and deaths) every pair off.
# First, a census term that is no longer the census's comes off now, not at the state's next yearly step, so it and
# the pairs are never both in force: one a rule switched off Full left, or one from a save made before the moved
# lines (no te_dg_q_b, which this build's step always sets with it).
te_demog_lines_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_dg_mb
			OR = {
				NOT = { te_demog_effects_run = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = te_dg_q_b }
			}
		}
		te_demog_rates_clear = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_demog_lines_apply = yes }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_ln_new value = te_demog_line_births }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_births }
					NOT = { var:te_dg_ln_births = local_var:te_dg_ln_new }
					# a pair lost while its sum stayed (a save quirk, a state that copied the variable): put it back
					AND = {
						NOT = { var:te_dg_ln_births = 0 }
						NOT = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_births_up }
						NOT = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_births_down }
					}
				}
			}
			te_demog_line_births_remove = yes
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_ln_births value = local_var:te_dg_ln_new }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_ln_births > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = te_demog_line_births_up multiplier = te_demog_line_births_up_mult }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_ln_births < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = te_demog_line_births_down multiplier = te_demog_line_births_down_mult }
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_ln_new value = te_demog_line_deaths }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_deaths }
					NOT = { var:te_dg_ln_deaths = local_var:te_dg_ln_new }

					AND = {
						NOT = { var:te_dg_ln_deaths = 0 }
						NOT = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_deaths_up }
						NOT = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_deaths_down }
					}
				}
			}
			te_demog_line_deaths_remove = yes

				limit = { var:te_dg_ln_deaths > 0 }

# THIS = a state: every pair off, with its stored sum (the census's refresh calls it when it first sets M).
te_demog_lines_clear = {
	te_demog_line_births_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_births }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_births
	}
	te_demog_line_deaths_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_deaths }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_deaths
	}
	te_demog_line_farmers_deaths_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_farmers_deaths }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_farmers_deaths
	}
	te_demog_line_laborers_deaths_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_laborers_deaths }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_laborers_deaths
	}
	te_demog_line_machinists_deaths_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_machinists_deaths }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_machinists_deaths
	}
	te_demog_line_peasants_deaths_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_peasants_deaths }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_peasants_deaths
	}
	te_demog_line_wealth_deaths_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_wealth_deaths }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_wealth_deaths
	}
}

te_demog_line_births_remove = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_births_up }
		remove_modifier = te_demog_line_births_up
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_births_down }
		remove_modifier = te_demog_line_births_down
	}
}
